##### Project general facts


Yas Park Views is an elegant villa community by Aldar on Yas Island, designed to offer a contemporary lifestyle surrounded by greenery and open spaces. The development features a collection of modern three-, four-, and five-bedroom villas, each thoughtfully crafted to provide spacious family living in a peaceful residential setting. Combining clean architectural lines with beautifully landscaped surroundings, Yas Park Villas creates a welcoming environment where privacy, comfort, and modern design come together effortlessly.

The community is designed to encourage an active and family-oriented lifestyle, with every villa complemented by its own private garden and swimming pool, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Surrounded by lush landscapes and located within one of Abu Dhabi’s most vibrant destinations, Yas Park Views offers residents a tranquil retreat while remaining close to the island’s renowned leisure, entertainment, and lifestyle attractions.

Inside, the residences feature spacious contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize comfort and functionality. Homeowners can personalize their living spaces by selecting from two elegant interior design themes, creating a home that reflects their individual style. Equipped kitchens provide everyday convenience, while built-in wardrobes enhance practicality, resulting in homes that combine timeless elegance with modern family living.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, is a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim. This man-made island covers approximately 9.6 square kilometers (3.7 square miles) and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. One of its highlights is the renowned Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

At the heart of Yas Island is Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer. This extraordinary park enthralls visitors with its thrilling rides, including the record-breaking Formula Rossa roller coaster that accelerates to speeds of up to 240 kilometers per hour (149 miles per hour). Ferrari World also presents captivating exhibits showcasing the brand's history and heritage.

Yas Island's aquatic paradise, Yas Waterworld, offers a refreshing escape from the desert heat. Packed with exhilarating water slides, rides, and pools suitable for all ages, this water park is a must-visit for families and adventure-seekers. Yas Waterworld incorporates Emirati culture and traditions into its design, creating a one-of-a-kind experience that showcases the region's rich heritage.
